QuestInfo.name: Taming a Jaguar
QuestInfo.0: In order to use the Riding Skill, the most basic skill for Wild Hunters, you must first capture a jaguar. Talk to #b#p2151002##k to find out how.
QuestInfo.1: Wild Hunters can tame and mount jaguars. Now, you just need to find out where the jaguars are...\n
QuestInfo.2: You can enter the #b#e#m931000500##n#k any time by talking to #eBlack Jack#n at the #b#e#m931000500##n#k. Once there, you can use the Capture skill to tame a new jaguar.
